title: Pinocembrin Reduces Arthritic Symptoms in Mouse Model via Targeting Sox4 Signaling Molecules.
authors: Ahmed, Emad A; Ibrahim, Hairul-Islam Mohamed; Khalil, Hany Ezzat
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物Pinocembrin通过靶向转录因子Sox4缓解小鼠关节炎症状，虽含分子对接验证PCB与Sox4蛋白结合，但核心是药物疗效与信号通路，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune, multifactorial, inflammatory disorder characterized by hyperplasia and infiltration of inflammatory cells at the synovial lining leading to destruction of cartilage and bone tissues. Pinocembrin (PCB) is a natural flavonoid extracted as a pure molecule from honey, propolis, and some plants. In this study, we evaluated the antiarthritic effect of PCB in adjuvant induced arthritis (AIA) mice. Treating the AIA mouse model with PCB reduced the arthritis symptoms/score, including edema size, extent of hind paw redness, abnormal movement, and holding inability. At the pathological level, PCB significantly decreased the joint erosion and percentages of infiltrated inflammatory cells. Biochemically, PCB interacts with the transcription factor, SRY-related HMG-box 4 (Sox4), and then modulates its dysregulated expression and the expression of Sox4/Stat3 signaling molecules in AIA mice. These molecules include tumor necrosis factor-alpha, nuclear transcription factor kappaB, and cyclooxygenase-2, besides the microRNAs; miR-132, miR-202-5p, and miR-7235, which are dysregulated in adjuvant-induced arthritis model relative to the control mice. The possible PCB interaction with Sox4 transcriptional protein was confirmed through molecular docking where three hydrogen bonds were formed at ARG and LYS residues at a stable binding energy of -4.72. Taken together, our data demonstrate that PCB could serve as a therapeutic drug in treatment of RA.
abstract_zh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种慢性自身免疫性、多因素炎症性疾病，其特征为滑膜衬里层炎症细胞增生和浸润，导致软骨和骨组织破坏。松属素（PCB）是一种从蜂蜜、蜂胶及某些植物中提取的纯天然黄酮类化合物。本研究评估了PCB在佐剂诱导性关节炎（AIA）小鼠中的抗关节炎作用。用PCB治疗AIA小鼠模型可减轻关节炎症状/评分，包括水肿大小、后爪发红程度、异常运动及抓握无力。在病理水平上，PCB显著减少关节侵蚀和浸润炎症细胞的百分比。在生化层面，PCB与转录因子SRY相关HMG-box 4（Sox4）相互作用，进而调节其在AIA小鼠中的异常表达及Sox4/Stat3信号分子的表达。这些分子包括肿瘤坏死因子-α、核转录因子κB和环氧化酶-2，此外还有微小RNA；miR-132、miR-202-5p和miR-7235，这些在佐剂诱导性关节炎模型中相对于对照小鼠表达失调。通过分子对接确认了PCB与Sox4转录蛋白的可能相互作用，其中在ARG和LYS残基处形成三个氢键，结合能稳定为-4.72。综上所述，我们的数据表明PCB可作为治疗RA的治疗药物。
